newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice ends limit-down on stop-loss orders.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice ends limit-down on stop-loss orders.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures ended limit-down on Tuesday on stop-losses orders, traders said.
The only traded September 1996 contract ended at 2,459 yuan ($296) per tonne, down 55 yuan. It opened at that level and stayed there throughout the session.
Traders said that rising inventory and institutions building short positions at high levels made many individuals liquidate their long positions.
"Most individuals were speculators and do not need spot goods," one trader said.
Combined volume fell to 5,600 tonnes from 27,300.
Analysts expect rice to continue falling in the next few days.
